name: Maiden of Milk: Breast Expansion
source: A girl who gets a surprise visit from her grandmother. Her grandmother drops off some of her coveted cupcakes. The girl begins to find that her breasts are rapidly growing and that her grandmother is no where to be found! Why is her chest growing and how can she make it stop?​
translation: 祖母突然来访的女孩。她的祖母送来了一些她梦寐以求的纸杯蛋糕。女孩开始发现她的乳房正在迅速长大，而她的祖母却不见踪影！为什么她的胸部会变大，怎样才能让它停止？​
